detail: General Updates - Disclosure regarding completion of Offer for Sale of Equity Shares by Promoters of the Company. In continuation of the intimations dated November 02, 2026 and November 03, 2026, we wish to inform you that the Offer for Sale (OFS) of equity shares of face value of ₹10 each of the Company by the Promoters, namely, Mr. Ashokkumar Haridas Lal and Mr. Jitendrakumar Haridas Lal (Selling Promoters), was undertaken through the stock exchange mechanism on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE).

sources.blurb: Primary NSE disclosure (SEBI LODR Reg. 30 / regulator filing) for this corporate event.
